sections.digitalText: 止忌修方. 犯之，損小口. 盖十五歲以下不成丁，皆謂之小口.
sections.disposition: Spatial repair only; age/outcome claim not implemented.

sections.digitalText: 止占方道. 如小，可修葺. 犯之，便損血財. 若大修作，得三奇，轉運帝星，月家，陽龍陰兎帝星到方，宜大修作，吉星能壓之.
sections.disposition: Small-versus-large repairs and special stars have unresolved context/join; no verdict.

sections.digitalText: 若與打頭火同位，或年獨火飛得丙丁二字，同到方道，則其火方發，無凶神，倂不妨.
sections.disposition: Two alternatives for co-location involving 打頭火 or annualfire丙丁; no automatic activation.

sections.digitalHeading: 劍鋒殺 月火血 天瘟
sections.digitalText: 此諸凶神占方，犯劍峰，損血財，小口，火血，損六畜，天瘟，招瘟，忌小可修作. 吉神臨方，大修作無妨.
sections.disposition: Small/large repair and benefic-star condition; source effects unverified.

sections.digitalText: 止忌修換. 如甲子年二月在猪牢，止忌修整猪牢. 又如甲子年三月占廳堂，亦忌修整廳堂，若鼎新造作，則不避忌. 又論其殺，止論月分，不問節氣. 修廳殺宅長，修堂殺宅母，修門廊殺次長，修廚殺新婦.
sections.disposition: Explicit existing-repair/new-build distinction and no-jieqi source claim; two printed year/month/site examples.

sections.digitalText: 惟忌修中宮. 若修作動土，損血財. 得八節，三奇或月家九紫，日家九紫，得日吉到中宮，修作無妨.
sections.disposition: Centre-only repair and star exception; no health/outcome or building action.

sections.digitalText: 若在中宮修作，大忌動土. 犯輕，損血財，犯重，損人. 如到中宮，吉凶二事，皆不宜用鼓樂. 犯者，損血財. 設使畢欲用之，從門外遠處，打起鼓樂，行入廳堂，無妨. 若修作，値陽龍陰兎，得三奇或月家九紫，日家九紫飛到方，不碍. 如其月有州縣，官符，在中宮吉凶二事，欲用鼓樂，亦宜前例. 如修作，宜魔禳斬牲. ○ 又禳法：年月血刃，屬金，若先以火於占處大燒，當卽修造無妨.
sections.disposition: Historical music/ritual/burning/sacrifice passage retained for audit; excluded from product actions/remedies.

sections.digitalText: 其殺止占方道. 若得三奇，祿馬，陽龍陰兎，走馬六壬等吉星到方，宅舍，修作，尤宜用之.
sections.disposition: Direction-only建破魁罡 with conditionalstaroverride; not all日建破.

sections.digitalText: 止忌開山. 從諸吉到山. 犯者，便損血財，倂招口舌. 如合得吉利年月，先見此災，後亦進益.
sections.disposition: 開山only; auspicious-month warning/outcomes not harmonized.

sections.digitalText: 止占方道. 犯者，只損人口. 【又名逆小兒殺.】
惟占山頭方向. 尤忌修方整換. 犯之，隨手火發，吉，不能壓服.
sections.disposition: Facing/repair operation plus nooverride source claim; no physicalfireprediction.

sections.digitalText: 若與日家，打頭火同位，則其火便發.
sections.disposition: Daily co-location required; no automatic fire/outcome.

sections.digitalHeading: 飛宮 地軸 帝舍 帝車 帝輅
sections.digitalText: 逐年各月所占之方，如欲修作，求三奇，陽龍陰兎帝星，走馬六壬，年轉，運行衙帝星，其中但得一位吉神到，修作不妨.
sections.disposition: Lists severalstars and at-least-one condition for repair; no inferreddate/directionpositions.

sections.digitalHeading: 六甲孕神 六甲忌方 牧養六畜忌方
sections.digitalText: 其殺所占，止論月分. 切忌修整.
sections.disposition: Monthly target plus repair only; no new-build/generaloutcomerule.

sections.digitalText: 其殺止論月分. 所占之處，如正月在門戶，只忌正月內修整門戶. 犯之，招狐狸，豺狗，損耗六畜. 餘月倣此.
sections.disposition: Januarydoor example and repair-only restriction; no all12monthlocations invented.

sections.digitalText: 其殺止論月分. 所占之處，如正月在竈，正月之內，只忌修整竈. 犯之，主宅長，家母兩足浮腫. 餘月倣此. 【如用土公敗日，則不忌.】
sections.disposition: Januarystove example; 土公敗日 explicit exception preserved unknown until declared.

sections.digitalText: 《備要》云：“犯遊龍，伏龍，主損目.” 一本云：“犯宅龍，防惡犬.” 盖此殺各月所値之處，止忌修換，只論月分，並不問節氣. 【如用土公敗日動土則不避忌.】
sections.disposition: Repair-only and nojieqi source claim; 土公敗日動土 exception separate; attributed備要/一本 claim kept.

sections.digitalHeading: 牛黃 牛胎 馬黃 馬胎 羊胎 猪胎 猫胎
sections.digitalText: 此諸凶神所値，止論月分，不問節氣.
sections.disposition: Nojieqi/monthclaim with animalpregnancylabels; not mappedto human natal/calendar predictions.

sections.digitalText: 刀砧殺忌日倂方. 千斤殺止忌方. 犯之，損耗六畜.
sections.disposition: 刀砧忌日並方 vs千斤方 only; differentdomains not merged.
